references.text: The description of the altar of burnt offering (מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה) to be made of acacia wood and bronze, which is the same altar that is to be anointed in Exod 30:28.
The execution of building the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils (כֵּלָיו), corresponding to what was to be anointed.
The description of the bronze basin (הַכִּיֹּר) and its stand (כַּנּוֹ) that the priests were to use for washing, the same basin mentioned here.
A summary of the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the bronze basin with its stand, which Bezalel was to make.
The altar of burnt offering with its bronze grate, carrying poles, and all its utensils, as well as the bronze basin with its stand, are mentioned as parts of the tabernacle equipment.
The execution of building the bronze basin and its stand from bronze made from the mirrors of the women.
Moses is instructed to set up the altar of burnt offering and the bronze basin, and to place water in it.
The command to anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, as well as the bronze basin and its stand, to consecrate them.
Moses carries out the setting up of the altar of burnt offering and the bronze basin in the tabernacle.
Moses anoints the altar and all its utensils, as well as the bronze basin and its stand, to consecrate them.
All the utensils (כֵּלָיו) of the altar used in the service are mentioned in connection with the duties of the Levites.
The completion of the work in chapter 39 confirms that the exact requirements from the instructions in chapter 30 have been fulfilled.
